batting.name: Azhar Mahmood
batting.dismissal: c S Kaul b A Nehra

batting.name: R Sathish
batting.dismissal: c BJ Rohrer b A Nehra

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c M Vohra b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b P Awana

batting.name: M Morkel
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b PP Chawla

balls.text: and that's a four to end the over, was fuller on the middle stump and he's smashed it straight, the long-on was wide and beats him easily to the fence

slower one and it's hit straight up and down to long-on, who has to go to his left and take a straight-forward one, that's five really good deliveries this over from one who hasn't had a good night otherwise
very full and does not time it too well, was looking for his favourite stroke over the long-on fielder, in the end he digs it away to long-on for a single
fuller outside the off stump and taps it down to long-off for a single
shorter again and wants to pull it, does not get it anywhere on the middle, rolls back to the bowler
wants to get it over fine-leg yet again by moving across, slowness of the ball beats him and it lobs up to the keeper
half a chopper there, was fuller and he jabs it almost like Dhoni would, stops from having the full swing India's captain does and it goes to long-on for a single
the carnage continues, Satish walks across for the second time this over, it's a slower one but that does not defeat him, waits on the delivery and chips it over fine-leg
this is too quick for him, short of length and he was looking to pull it away, gets high on the bat and it goes to long-off, single taken and Satish wanted the second, but sent back
there you go again, it's gone all the way, all, all, all the way! fuller on the off and he's absolutely swung it, hits some roof in the stadium
short of length yet again and pulled away, does not get it off the middle of the bat, and falls short of the fine-leg fielder
whoa, what a shot, he was expecting that to be full, outside the off stump and moves outside the off and flicks it over the short fine-leg fielder for a four

and again, this is too simple for Miller, first he hits one that's too full and now he's swung his bat at one that's too short, gets in that arc again and that, literally, has gone outside the park, outside the ground, all the way
slower one from Kaul, on a length and he was looking to pull it away, swings it too quickly and beaten
and that's a poor ball now, full-toss, outside the off stump which allows him a free swing of the arm, six over long-off

there is power, and there is power in shots, and that was some shot! it was fuller and Miller absolutely crunches it, Warner had to move a few steps to his right to stop that and he fails to do that, goes for a four!
yorker length outside the off stump, he was looking to unwind there but gets only the toe end of the bat through to long-on
shorter in length and he was looking to deposit it over the fence yet again, this does not connect well and it goes straight to long-on, who is a touch wider
shorter in length and that's cut to the left of the point fielder, Nehra at third-man is slow to get to it, but finally makes a tumbling stop
short one and that's shot is so West Indian in it's flair! was short of length and he was looking casually mow it over mid-wicket, connects well and goes for a six
short of length yet again, pushed to the point fielder, this time he does field it
short of length outside the off stump and he pushes it to the point fielder, dives to his left, fumbles and they are able to come back for the second to third-man

gone, now he's caught, a scratchy innings from Marsh finally comes to end, he was looking to hit the length ball over the long-on fielder but again, does not time it well and it's straight to the fielder
fuller on the middle and swinging back into the batsman, drives it to long-off for a single
very full and he only manages to dig it out to the point fielder, went really fast there
outside the off and fuller, goes after it, slices it to third-man for a single
remember that arc, remember that park, that's exactly what many are waiting for and that's exactly what he's finally delivered, length ball and smashed over the mid-wicket region for a six
fuller on the leg stump and he drives it down to long-on for a single
wow and this is flown to the off side, through the slips, edged too and for a four!
inside edged to the fence! finally gets the runs, not off the middle but they were getting desperate there, was looking to pull it away and it beats the short fine-leg easily
and beaten yet again! short of length and swinging away from the bat, he was looking to play it through to third-man but misses
short of length, outside the off stump and he was looking to walk down the track, gets it off the middle but straight to point
ooh, beaten now, was swinging away from the batsman and he was defending at it, beaten
shorter in length and pushed to mid-wicket, straight to the fielder
smashed again, fuller and outside the off stump, rushes to the sweeper fielder who does not have to move much, only one
slows down the pace drastically and this, he times well! he was looking to punch it down the ground and does well, fizzes off to the right of the long-on fielder
wide, wide outside the off stump, that's swinging away further too and that's gone for a wide
and again, gets no timing on it, was fuller and smash he tries, gets it some part which is not off the middle and it rolls away to long-off for a single
shorter in length and pushed to the right of the bowler, he dives there but fails to stop it
and just falls short of the third-man, he was looking to slog it away, gets an outside edge and bounces in front of the fielder
shorter in length this time, on the off stump, pushed to the off side for a single
wow, what a shot, that was pure timing, fuller outside the off and smashed through the covers, there was a sweeper in place but he was getting nowhere close to it
that's full-toss and on the off stump, wants to smash it away but gets it to long-off for a single
and again, a good over, short of length and he's defended it to that same point fielder
slower, shorter and he was first ducking before trying to steer it away, goes to point
quick and on his pads, was looking to flick it away, hits his pads and goes very close to the bowler on his follow-through
length ball outside the off stump, gets it off the middle but straight to the point fielder
not too short and outside the off stump, he still goes back and opens the face, steers it to third-man for a single
short of length and tapped to the off side for a single
wanted to pull this one now, was short enough but misses the middle of the bat, inside edged that
slower one and outside the off stump, he wants to cut it away to the off side, straight to point
on a good length outside the off stump, pushes it to the point fielder this time

and wow, what a catch!  it's fuller and I think it's slower too, he was looking to chip it over the bowler's head, gets a good part of the bat, looks like it's going all the way, all the time, before Sid Kaul leaps up high and plucks it out at the edge of the fence!
gloved it away to the fine, fine-leg for a four, it was shorter in length and was looking to pull it away, gets something on it and easily beats the keeper through to the fence for a four
slower delivery from Nehra and he cuts it away to the deep cover for a single
fuller outside the off stump and he tries to drill it through the in-field, gets it straight to the cover fielder who's at the end of the circle and they get an easy one
short of length and wide outside the off stump, guides it to the third-man for a single
outside the off stump, was wider too too, slower as well, and the cut shot is mistimed to the covers, away for a quick one
outside the off and had the room to cut, misses, through to the keeper
and now Mahmood wants to spank him over the in-field, Yadav's inside the circle at mid-on and he's got to rush across to his right to field that one
fuller outside the off stump and that's driven so hard that even though Yadav has to travel across to wide long-off to field it, they can get it only a single
swing away from the bat and Marsh is in that kind of a mood now that he will go after it, had width too and smacks it but straight to Warner at deep covers
smashed away but Warner does well to cover at the sweeper, rushes away to his left and quickly slides around and stops it, restricts it to two
on the off stump and on a good length, he opens the face of the bat, guides it to third-man for a single
on his pads this time and he wants to pull it away, does get it off the bat and it rolls down to the fine-leg region
outside the off stump and he tries to push it through the point fielder, Rohrer does well to dive to his left and stalls the possibility of anything more than a single
fuller on the middle stump at a slightly lower pace, pushed back and this time they are away for a quick single
and just as we were talking of the good length's he bowling, he pitches one shorter and is pulled away to backward square-leg for a four
slightly off line this time and the batsman tries to flick it away, gets some pad on its way to the leg side
a touch shorter this time, not too much and it's quick too, Mahmood's got to go back quickly and defend it
he's not missing his length here, continues to push it fuller at the batsman and he defends it back to the bowler
on the middle stump and fuller, he pushes it to mid-on now, not for a single
fuller from Yadav, he's bowling a good length here and pushes it to the mid-off fielder, wanted a single but sent back
shorter outside the off stump and he can only push it into the covers
tries out a bouncer and Mahmood does not get any part of the middle of the bat, tries to hook him away but only lobs up to the leg side
down the leg side, swinging back in but starts at a poor line and it's called a wide
slower on the middle stump and he taps it to mid-on rushes off for a quick single and the fielder there has a shy at the stumps, misses

gone, caught, it went high up in the air, allows me to count all those stars there, that's how high it goes and Pathan has done well to catch that, well done! was looking to flick it away forcefully on the leg-side but that was far fuller than the previous one and gets a leading edge, one down after a good start
na, na, you don't drop short to Gilly at that pace, he swivel-pulls it and gets it to the mid-wicket fence for a four
that's a sudden drop in pace from the previous over, shorter in length and he wants to drive it through, gets it to short cover to Jayawardene
outside the off stump, on a length and tapped to the off side, Marsh takes a couple of steps out and slips, luckily for him it's only a couple of steps and he quickly gets back
short ball this time, as a change in length, he had pitched most of the previous ones up to the bat but this is a bouncer to test out the batsman, who goes for a hook, misses
and again, that same swing back into the bowler, gets an inside edge to the leg side for a single
what pace, 139.9 km/hr and it was swinging back into the batsman too, was too quick for him, beats the inside edge again, hits the pads for a single
again on the fuller length and nipping back into the batsman, hits his pads but was drifting down the leg side, away for a leg bye
fuller outside the off stump, better length from Yadav than what he has seen so far and he cannot get it away, does not hit the middle of the bat
shorter in length and wider again, why would you do that so many times, Marsh cuts it away but does not get it into the gap, straight to point
finally gets the line back close the batsman, on the middle stump and he can only tap it to the leg side for a single

poor ball, good shot, six runs. Was wide outside the off stump and short in length too, in this mood, Gilly hardly needs any more invites to go after it and slapped square over the off side for a six!
and again, this time it's not a six, bounces a few times before it gets there but it is short and wide and he's hitting it over mid-off for four!

and that's the first one of the night, was in his slot here and Gilly was not holding back, he has some form behind his back and wants to cash in, goes over the mid-off fielder and as it turns out, it goes all the way
shorter in length but he's getting them to swing from that length too, fails to latch on to that one off the middle and it rolls over to the off side
short of length and tapped to the off side for a quickly-taken single
short, wide and wants to go after it, it wasn't too close to the bat though and he misses

on a length outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat through to the third-man for a single, it travelled as quickly as the catch had to Yadav, the same fielder fumbles again but restricts it to one
whoa, what bounce there, it was outside the off stump, and jumps up, the ball and the batsman both, misses the outside edge through to the wicket-keeper
short of length, outside the off stump, he was looking to cut it away but misses, what I think was an under-edge
round the stumps, not too short and he defends it back to the bowler
on a good length but quite closer to the stumps and Gilly, for a change, does not want to punish the ball, only taps it to the off side
short of length, outside the off and he wanted to smash it yet again, misses it again

edged and it's gone through the slips for a four! wouldn't call that a drop, he was looking to open the face of the bat, gets it to the left of Sehwag, who dives full length but does not get a hand to it at first slip
another one that's hit hard, these two are trying to get the leather off it, wanted to pull through mid-wicket, but the mid-on dives to his left and fields well!
bludgeoned away over the mid-off for a four! it was full and it was wide enough to swing his bat, he loves doing that and that's been punished, mid-off had no chance there
shorter in length from Nehra, and on the off stump, not as quick as the Morne over obviously and he defends it to the off side
fuller outside the off stump and slightly fuller, lets it go through to the keeper by shouldering arms
short of length and that's some extra bounce for the bowler, he takes his bottom hand off and defends
dropped, that went fast, that went straight, that went flat and that has hit him at some pace! was short of length and he goes for the cut, straight to the fielder, Yadav, who spills it
round the stumps and on the middle stump, was short of length too and he defends off the back foot, off for a quick one
what-a-shot! Marsh's hit his third through the off side and it's gone to the fence again, short of length and smack, slapped it away
short of length, outside the off stump and he punches it to third-man, hits it on the up too
good shot and equally well-fielded, this was fuller outside the off and he drilled it to get it through extra-covers, captain MJ dives to his right from mid-off and stops it
that's a poor delivery, he lost his line there and drifted on to his pads, there was some movement down the leg side and he gets some bat on it to beat the fine-leg
on his pads and was looking to work it down the leg-side, hits his pads and it rolls away to the off side
and it swings the other way now, was on the middle stump before moving down the leg side, easy call of a wide this time
fuller this time and Marsh's beaten, was fuller this time and was looking to drive it away, swings away from him and misses the outside edge
wide outside the off stump and after hitting those two boundaries, he wanted to go for it again, last minute he lets it go hoping it would be called a wide, touch inside the line
on his pads, quick too and he taps it to mid-on, away for a quick single
and now on the other side of the same fielder at point, tapped on the up and flies off to the deep cover fence for another boundary!
four for Marsh! and it's a good shot too, was a tad wide and he opens the face of the bat and cracks it through the right of point, absolutely ripped off the surface for a four
inside edge that bounces off the pitch and rolls over to the off side, was a goodish length ball outside the off stump and he tries to tap it away
ooh, swing away this time, was fuller this time but a tad wider and he lets that go through to the keeper
again it's touch on the shorter side and he opens the face of the bat to guide it through to third-man for the first run of the night
short of a length and on the middle stump, slight curve away and defended off the back foot
top-edged and caught at long-on, that's gone straight to the fielder, who takes a simple catch to find off the game
and another six! Morne has read that quicker one well and spanked it over long-on for a six!
slogged away but it's straight to mid-wicket for a single
quicker one outside the off stump, shorter and tapped down to long-off for a single
shot, six first ball for Morne! that was a slower one, tossed up to the bat and he's been hit straight over the bowler
faster one, shorter too, 117 km/hr, smacks the stumps while looking to slog it away, he could have read that one, just does not time the shot too well and that's the end of that
tries to slog it away and gets an inside edge on to the pads, runs away for a single
and four more! wow, full-toss outside the off stump, and the fielder is up inside the circle, gets the gap and gets four!
was looking to walk towards outside the off stump but he was followed and only opens the bat through to third-man
round the stumps now and he's slogged it again but this goes on the bounce to deep mid-wicket
and again, that's gone for six more! it also means that the bats broken too, length ball, not too much and it's been thumped over deep mid-wicket to make it two in two!
fuller outside the off and that's been deposited over long-on for a six! the lack of speed allows him to swing through the line
fuller on the leg stump line, he wants to play it through the covers but gets it straight to the extra-cover fielder
full-toss on his pads and flicks it away to the leg side for a single
up and over and to the fence for a four, it was a shorter one and not too quick too, so could adjust to the stroke after looking to go under it, upper cuts over the keeper
advances down the track and can only push it down to long-on for a single BR wanted a second but Gautam says no, slow running that from him
edged through to third-man for a single this time
was looking to come down the track, can only push it to extra-cover where Mandeep fields and wants to have a shy but someone in the field asks him to hold on it
up and over the short fine-leg fielder, he was looking to repeat what MJ did earlier, only this time he gets it finer and easily beats the fielder
short of length again, and tapped to the off side, straight to the fielder
short of length and wanted to drive it away, gets an inside edge

and again, he was looking to slog it over the mid-wicket, was a slower one and badly mistimes it, gets it off the toe back to the bowler who is very surprised and does not get his hand out, rolls down to long-on
whoa, how can that go for a six? he was looking to swing it across the line and almost checks the stroke, gets the outside edge and it goes over third-man for a six!

finally they catch him, finally MJ's out, it was a slower one, outside the off and he tried to go across and scoop it over the deep square-leg fielder, gets it off the middle but straight to the fielder, who gobbles him up this time
short of length and that's hooked away this time for a four, good one off the middle of the bat
shorter in length and he wanted to cut it away, bit more bounce and it beats the outside edge
full-toss and pulled to deep square-leg, he's disappointed he does not get it in the gap there
short and into the body, that's hooked away for a four, it went really quick to fine-leg
short of length and tapped to the off side for a quick single
angling back into the batsman and he drives it down to long-on for a single
squeezed out through fine third-man for a four, was fuller outside the off stump and that's jabbed away to the fence
short of length on the middle stump, tapped to the leg side for a single
whoa, almost hits the batsman with that full-toss, it was an attempted yorker and it seems to have slipped, goes over his head and needs to say a quick sorry to the batsman
outside the off stump and he was looking to give himself room, gets no where close to it, it was nipping away too
fuller on the off stump and drives it to mid-off for a single
fuller on the off stump and drives it, does not get it too far, only to the extra-cover fielder for a single
and just like that, he's now back! short of length and he's cracked it over point for a four
fuller and driven down to long-on for a single
that's the quicker delivery from Chawla, 123.9 km/hr, full-toss and swept away to the fine-leg for a four!
where were you all this while, the middle of the bat! it was fuller and he goes down the track and thwacks it over long-on for a six!
on his pads and he sees it, wants to sweep it away and misses yet again, gets hit on his pads
tosses it up to the bat outside the off stump and he was looking to hit it over the long-on region, gets it away to the fielder
shorter in length, pushed to the leg side, it's gently done too and they are able to come back for the second
on the off stump and he wants to crack it through the covers, gets bit of an inside edge and they go through for a quick one, needed a dive from Rohrer to get in

short of length, pulled away to the deep square-leg fence for a four, actually that was a good effort from Mandeep who needed to run to his right, fields and throws the ball but it goes too far and into the fence
short of length, bouncer and he was looking to pull it away, misses the top edge of the bat, this game is going nowhere
fuller outside the off stump and he was still looking to go over the leg side, can only tap it back
short of length outside the off stump and he looks to steer it down to third-man, beaten
wants to go inside out but gets it away to the deep cover fielder alone
another quicker one on his pads and was looking to flick it away, the pace beats him once again and it rolls over to short fine-leg
on the middle stump and inside edged to the leg side for a single
fuller, slower and he drives it down to deep mid-wicket for a single
quicker one, bowled at 117 km/hr and Rohrer gets his bat down just in time
shorter in length and tapped away to the leg side, between backward square-leg and deep square-leg for a couple of runs

dropped again! MJ's been dropped for the third time this innings, it was up to the batsman who goes down the track and smack it over the fielder, goes straight to Mandeep, who spills it! straight-forward as they come!
big appeal for lbw, he was walking across to the off stump and misses the bat, it hits his pads and there's a big appeal there, the umpire was having none of it
on a length and outside the off stump, without any feet movement, he was looking to cut it, misses the outside edge

edged and gone this time, four down now and Delhi does not have too many on the board! it was on a length and outside the off stump, was looking to drive through the line but gets only an outside edge through to the keeper
up to the bat this time and Sehwag opens up his stance and hits it over the in-field for a four
short of length and angling in, Sehwag wants to whip it away, misses the shot and it hits the pads
shorter in length and he wanted to go back and slash it away, the pace beats him and it's gone through to Gilly
shortens his length and he pushes it to the off side for a single, they weren't looking for the second till very late, but seeing the fielder not too near the ball, they get back
shorter in length and tapped to the off side for a single
on his pads and this is flicked away to fine-leg for a four, was slightly quicker but poor line
outside the off stump and wants to cut, gets an inside edge through to the keeper on the bounce, hits him too
missed by the batsman and missed by the keeper, in the middle of that, it misses the stumps too and goes through for four byes, he was looking to swing at it
inside out, four over extra-cover, it was fuller and floated up, Sehwag isn't messing around that
shorter, quicker, outside the off and he wants to cut, for the umpteenth time tonight, he gets no bat on that one
on the pads and he was looking to walk down and flick it away, misses and it's gone through to the keeper
shorter in length and on the middle stump and wow it's swung away from there too, beats the outside of the bat
short of length and tapped to the off side and they get a single, the throw misses the stumps and they are able to come back for the second as an overthrow
short of length and on the off stump, pushes it to deep covers for a single
short of length and on the off stump, opens the face of the bat and runs it through to third-man for a single
outside the off and cut away to backward point, single easily taken
slightly off line, it was on the middle stump and swinging down his pads, gets something on it and it rolls away to fine-leg for a four, leg-byes given
outside the of stump and short enough to play the cut, gets an inside edge and it goes on the bounce behind
on his pads and shorter in length, wants to flick it away, hits the pads and rolls away to the leg side
and swings back into the batsman now, he was looking to give himself room to cut but the jag-back beats the stroke
finally some thing off the middle, finally a four, it was fuller and this one does not swing anywhere, Sehwag goes after it and gets it over the mid-off fielder
wow and he shoulders arms yet again, outside the off and lets it go
a touch outside the off stump and swinging further away, through to the keeper as MJ lets it go through
shorter in length and he was looking to open the face of the bat, gets it away to third-man for a single
hits the pads and high, was looking to walk across and defend but no bat near that one, cross over for a leg-bye
on the middle stump and tapped to the leg side for a single

run-out missed, overthrows for a four! it was inside edged to the pads, wanted to go for a single, MJ said no, then he said yes when Sehwag was going back, Miller came in to field and throws it to the non-strikers end, misses with MJ way out and Praveen at mid-on does not back up
on a good length and defended to the off side

wow, well attempted that but just eludes the fielder! he was looking to walk down and hit it over the fielders inside the circle on the off side, the ball loops and Mandeep runs back and dives, gets bit of a hand on it, but fails to latch on to it
short of length and swinging back into the batsman, he goes back and flays at it through point for a single
whoa, what-a-shot! shorter in length this time and he goes under it and upper cuts it, just over the keeper and for a four
swings, misses, this was slightly looser from the bowler, wide outside the off stump and on a length, after all the good bowling, Sehwag wanted to go after it, again beats him
fuller on the off stump, and swinging back to the batsman, he was looking to go at it before putting his bat down in time to defend
and past the outside edge when he was looking to flick it over the leg side, it was fuller and did not play it straight, swung away and beaten!
ooh, almost another! it was full enough and there was bit of swing back, hits the pad and there's an appeal that gets stifled, think there was an inside edge
outside the off yet again and he lets it go through to the keeper
outside edged it to the third-man for a single, it was on a length and swinging away, opens the face and gets bit of an edge
on the off stump and tapped to the off side, straight to the off side
on the pads and fuller, tapped to the leg side for a single

edged and gone again! first baller for Warner, it was fuller outside the off and he was looking to defend at it, took some swing away from the bat and it flies straight to Marsh in the slips, taken easily and Delhi are in a mire

edged and gone, this has been a difficult stay for Pathan, and on a track where there's so much  swing it reminded me of his innings as a Test opener in Australia, was outside the off and he went after it, gets an edge and is caught!
swing and miss, was going down the track and wanted to pull it away, got nowhere close to the bat, huge gap between the bat and the ball
fuller on the off stump and up to the bat, he wants to drive it away from the body, gets it to mid-off
swing away again, on a length and that's tapped to the off side
almost, it was quick and straight and full and there seemed to be some swing back, gets bit of a bat on it, on to the pads and rolls near the stump
shortens his length and gets it closer to the middle stump, bit of swing away and defended to the off side
outside the off stump and swinging away from the batsman, lets it go through to the keeper
bowled him, too much swing and unlike MJ, Chand's defences are not too strong, the ball sneaks through the bat and the pad and the bails are scattered
inside edged on to his pads now, swinging away yet again and misses the middle
up and over and for a six, it's flown off the bat and over the covers for a maximum, fuller and he was still waiting on his back foot, gets off the middle too
ooh, what swing, late one too, jagging back into the batsman who was looking to go for an expansive stroke before having to defend quickly
manages to squeeze it through the crowded in-field and the third-man rushes to his right to field that, restricted to two
better shot that time, fuller and opens the face of the bat and guides it, straight to the point fielder
outside the off and he wanted to drive it through the covers, no foot movement as we have seen from him throughout the tournament, beats the outside edge
short of length and on the middle, tapped to the leg side
shorter in length and tapped to the off side, wants to go for a quick one and a direct hit from Miller would have seen MJ short at the non-striker's end
fuller and on middle stump and he drives it over the bowler's head, not timed too well that

edged and dropped at second slip (yep they have two of them there), outside the off stump and swinging, a deliberate attempt to open the face of the bat through to third-man, gets an edge and Mahmood drops it
and that swing again, he pulls his length back now, lot of movement there, lets that one go
fullish length and the batsman is looking to defend for now, pats it back to the bowler
on a fuller length this time and he comes out and defends it back to the bowler
and now swings away from the bat, and it does a lot too, on a length and lets it go through to the keeper
swinging back into the batsman, prodigious too, on a length and he was looking to get his bat down in time there
